$description: Semantic roles that stay the same in every theme. Components read these, or component tokens that alias them.

spacing.$description: The spacing vocabulary shared by every gap and padding prop: extraSmall, small, medium, large, extraLarge, extraExtraLarge. 'none' is the structural value 0 and has no token.

width.$description: Thickness of the keyboard focus outline.

offset.$description: Gap between a control and its focus outline so the ring never touches the control's own border.

small.$description: Dense toolbars; still above the 24px WCAG 2.2 target minimum.

medium.$description: Default for buttons, inputs and selects: 44px at the default text size.

disabled-opacity.$description: Disabled form fields are exempt from contrast requirements but must still look unavailable.

gutter.$description: Minimum inline padding between content and the viewport edge.

gutter-wide.$description: Upper bound for fluid page gutters on wide viewports.

measure.$description: Comfortable line length for running text.

transition.$description: Small state transitions such as a switch thumb.

emphasis.$description: Larger entrances such as a dialog appearing or a page arriving.

ambient.$description: One-time scene animations, such as the sunrise on the Overview.

enter.$description: Elements arriving on screen: a long, frictionless glide to rest.

blur.$description: Frost behind modal dialogs, so the page recedes without disappearing.

lens.$description: The red eye drawn by the logo and the not-found page. The same in both themes.

core.$description: The pinpoint at the center of the lens.

horizon.$description: The sunrise over a planet's limb on the Overview. The same in both themes: it is always night in orbit.

limb.$description: Sunlight catching the curved edge of the planet.

typeface.$description: Which family each kind of text is set in. Typography roles read these, so a product can change typefaces without touching the type scale.

text.$description: Body text, labels, captions and controls.

x-height.$description: x-height as a fraction of font size, Jost's own. Every typeface is scaled to it (font-size-adjust), so a size token looks the same size in every product.

typography.$description: Text roles. Text and Heading map their variants and sizes onto these.

caption.$description: Uppercase readouts: eyebrows, group headings, table captions.

control.$description: Buttons, navigation, tabs and badges, set in uppercase like panel labels.
